assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional rough constraints.
assumptions.impact: All spatial areas, partitions, drawings and ratios must be regenerated after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks and statutory land-use controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The submission expresses design intent, not approved regulatory controls.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, sections, station interfaces and traffic counts are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Mobility lines are conceptual connections and not engineering alignments.

assumptions.statement: Parcel boundaries and ownership are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Project areas and delivery entities cannot be assigned to specific parcels.

assumptions.statement: Verified footprints, heights, uses, ages and structural conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Building polygons are spatial prototypes; no parcel-level retain/renovate/demolish decision is made.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection areas and construction-control zones are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All heritage-park interventions remain low-impact, reversible concepts pending specialist review.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, flood, drainage, fire and energy-capacity data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Edge-compute and service nodes are service concepts, not engineering commitments.
The service plan identifies interfaces and a later audit, not capacity conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Events, funding, operators and schedules are proposals for co-design.
assumptions.impact: No activity, procurement, investment or government commitment is claimed.
